creator: sirakinb
title: Demo of a custom agent platform for a property manager: voice agent answers inbound calls and, on request, forwards to a human 'Live Queue' call center built inside the same platform

tools.name: Jackson (custom agent platform)
tools.detail: sidebar brand 'JACKSON'; agents listed: leasing agent, Voice Agent, Email Agent, Utilities Agent; 'Jackson Rental Homes' workspace; Live Queue call center with 'Incoming caller - Answer call / Decline'

claims: Voice agent answers inbound tenant calls; when caller asks for a person it forwards into a custom-built call center where multiple staff share one workspace and answer in real time
The call center was built directly inside the same custom agent platform the creator provisioned for the client
Caption: simply placing a voice AI agent in a business with a large call volume is not enough (human handoff needed)
how_to_steps: Forwards call into shared Live Queue UI
Staff click 'Answer call' on incoming-caller card
on_screen_only: Agent dashboard with sidebar: 'leasing agent', 'Voice Agent', 'Email Agent', 'Utilities Agent'; sections 'Workspace', 'CRM', 'Integrations', 'Phone numbers'
Chat pane showing a long agent prompt with headers 'Where we are', 'Prototype & process', numbered items 1-6 ('Production hosting...', 'Twilio/...' partially legible) and 'What do you want next?'
Right pane 'Jackson Rental Homes' sign-in screen
'Live Queue' screen: 'You're ready for calls' / 'Incoming caller' modal with 'Answer call' and 'Decline' buttons; counters '0' and '0s'

relevance.why: Shows the human-handoff piece missing from the liked Bland AI receptionist demo - the warm transfer to a web-based agent queue, which is what makes a voice agent sellable to a real service business.

implement_score.why: Human-transfer to a browser softphone (Twilio Client / Vapi transfer) is a weekend of Claude Code work and makes the AI-receptionist offer viable; but this is a bespoke client platform with no code shared.

verify: Which voice stack (Twilio? Vapi? Retell?) handles the transfer?
Is 'Jackson' a product or just the client name?
Latency/cost of warm transfer to browser WebRTC agents

gap.what: Adds the human-escalation / live call-queue pattern to the liked 'AI phone receptionist with Bland AI' content
